answer: To keep a sybil swarm from steering policy, put every new agent on a long, coverless probation, as exposed as a tundra, where every paid job and every funding hop is public. Influence stays near zero until several unaffiliated counterparties have settled work with that identity. If a signup gale arrives in one window, stretch the probation and cap the whole cohort's joint weight. Treat clusters that share hollow, look-alike funding as karst: the surface looks solid, but one probe collapses the chamber into a single seat.
